answer: Resist Sybils with maltster's barley steeping. A newcomer steeps 20 batches over 24 days; each batch's germination is checked by two maltsters from different maltings within 12 hours and logged on the malt board. A steeping germinating under 80% voids its credit and closes the malthouse 14 days; three bad steepings void the tally. Faking 1,000 agents needs 20,000 steepings and 40,000 checks, about $180,000 in wages plus 24 days of waiting, while one honest agent earns standing in a month. Like a meadow that only answers the echo of a true voyage, trust grows where the work is real.
